records.part: Self-Priming pumps for Effluent Channel Return Pump Station
records.reason: Self-Priming pumps shall be Gorman Rupp T series so as to ensure consistency and compatibility with other self-priming pumps onsite.

records.part: Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) for adjustable pumping rates
records.reason: VFDs shall be Allen Bradley Powerflex 755 so as to match other variable frequency drives at the WRRF site.
